name: How can I ensure a smooth transition when selling and buying simultaneously?

mainEntity.name: How can I ensure a smooth transition when selling and buying simultaneously?

acceptedAnswer.text: A smooth transition involves careful planning and coordination. We recommend getting pre-approved for a mortgage to understand your buying power, then strategically listing your current home. One practical tradeoff is to consider a 'rent-back' agreement in your current home's sale contract, which allows you to stay in your sold home for a short period after closing, providing extra time to move into your new property. This can be particularly useful in fast-moving markets like South Florida.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure a smooth transition by getting pre-approved for a mortgage and considering a rent-back agreement in your current home's sale to bridge the gap between closings.
